sanskrit_verse:
mahokṣo janayed vatsān yasya goṣu vraje caran
tasya te yasya tā gāvo moghaṃ syanditam ārṣabham
transliteration:
mahokṣo janayed vatsān yasya goṣu vraje caran
tasya te yasya tā gāvo moghaṃ syanditam ārṣabham
sph_interpretive_translation: One who causes calves to be born among another's cows while roaming in their pastures shall ensure that those cows yield no profit from the bull that was shed in vain.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the conscious ownership of action and its consequence
Causation is established through direct participation in karmic fields
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the level of intentional involvement
Restoration logic demands reversal of distorted value extraction
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of displaced energetic ownership
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent A initiates reproductive activity within resource domain B owned by agent C THEN A must neutralize all value transfer from B to A
IF biological proliferation occurs without consent of steward THEN resulting assets are nullified in favor of original owner
IF a bull has been shed for gain without lawful permission THEN any milk-production lineage derived therefrom shall revert to source consciousness
IF causal contamination disrupts integrity field THEN restoration protocol activates completion of displaced energetic balance
supreme_court_application: In matters involving unauthorized use of livestock or genetic propagation on another’s property, the threshold of responsibility lies not in intent alone but in the activation of causal consequence. The court must trace the flow of benefit and command its return. Authority flows from recognition of dharma-adhikara (rightful jurisdiction) rather than state-granted power.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that the act of causing birth among another's herd establishes energetic entanglement. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how the shedding of the bull activated an unrightful lineage. Responsibility is proportional to the degree of interference with natural dharmic order. No punitive measure is required—only the cessation of misaligned gain and restoration of rightful energetic sovereignty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vastu Reconciliation Process to dissolve contaminated lineage structures
Enforce Return-of-Yield protocol wherein all dairy gains are redirected to rightful custodian
Activate Conscious Ownership Acknowledgment whereby offender assumes full energetic liability
Deploy Completion Ritual to sever artificial karmic bindings created through unlawful propagation
final_declaration: Thus speaks the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam: This law proceeds from the Source itself, unwavering and absolute. Dharma stands restored when causality is reversed and consciousness realigned. There is no punishment—there is only awakening into right relationship. Let justice arise as truth made visible.
